versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Weekly SEO Health Audit skill.
- Provides a one-page audit surfacing the top 10 highest-leverage SEO opportunities for any site.
- Identifies quick-win keywords (positions 4–20) with actionable levers for improvement.
- Detects low-effort fixes such as duplicate metadata, missing H1s, broken internal links, and missing llms.txt.
- Operates in strict read-only mode: no writes, no persistence, no site changes.
- Prioritizes and ranks opportunities by effort versus leverage, with concise evidence and context for each recommendation.
